title: NightTrace
subtitle: Paranormal field journal
description: An investigation experience. Not a measurement. NightTrace is a paranormal field journal: investigate a place on the record, work it with instrument-like tools, and keep the night as a case file. Choose a hunt such as a ghost hunt, a cryptid outing, or a night outdoors, and the tools turn what your device senses into material for a case. Record signals you cannot place, mark what you ruled out, and seal the night as a report that reads like a field journal. Everything is generated locally and procedurally, on your device, with no account and no connections. Investigate your own place, on the record.
